versions.changelog:
claude-code-team-scaffold 1.0.0 – Initial release for setting up structured Claude Code AI project teams.

- Provides a multi-phase workflow to scaffold a Claude Code AI-assisted dev environment with code quality gates, lifecycle hooks, multi-agent support, and synchronized project discipline.
- Collects key project information for tech stack, agent roles, and workflow features via user prompts.
- Generates full .claude/ scaffolding: including settings.json with 6 event hooks, subagent definitions, slash commands, and planning-with-files support.
- Sets up both per-project and global persistent memory for code style and execution habits.
- Integrates CLAUDE.md as root discipline/spec file; entire framework enforces spec-flow, agent sync, and quality enforcement at each lifecycle stage.
- Includes clear changelog of difference vs. original AGENTS.md workflows (e.g., hooks model, command templates, memory handling, and discipline enforcement via hooks).
